name: foresight-marketplace
description: foresight — the gap-finding, visual-verification, and corpus-stewardship companion to iterative-tdd and hindsight.

plugins.name: foresight
plugins.description: Discovers regressions you haven't written yet and validates the ones you have. Reads code + docs, explores the running web/Android/iOS app with screenshots, catalogs every visible UI element with a user story, detects visual regressions between runs, maps UI elements and use cases to tests, audits and repairs existing .tdd/regression entries for replayability, and organizes them into prioritized feature groups that hindsight can consume. Includes a GitHub Copilot port.
